info.title: Postify API
info.description: Postify's public REST API. Authenticate with an organization API key (minted in Settings → API keys) sent as `Authorization: Bearer postify_live_…` or `x-api-key`. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`; every response carries `Request-Id`; API-key responses carry IETF draft-11 rate-limit headers.

body.description: The text to publish to this channel.

draft.description: Save as a draft (no scheduling, no publishing).

scheduled_at.description: Future publish time (ISO-8601). Mutually exclusive with `draft` and `publish_now`.

url.description: Media URL. Use the `url` returned by /v1/media assets.

alt.description: Accessibility alt text, where the platform supports it.

url.description: HTTPS URL on the default port (443). Loopback, private, link-local, and cloud-metadata addresses are rejected — at creation AND at every delivery.

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to (at least one).

url.description: Replacement delivery URL — re-validated through the same SSRF gauntlet as creation.

enabled.description: Enable or disable deliveries. Setting `true` on an auto-disabled endpoint clears its failure state and resumes deliveries.

UpdateWebhookEndpointRequest.description: Partial update — at least one field is required.

success_rate.description: Of the SETTLED attempts (acked/indexed vs failed/dlq), the fraction that succeeded. In-flight attempts are excluded; null when nothing has settled yet.

timeline.description: Publishes per UTC day over the last 14 days.

engagement.description: Summed platform engagement across synced posts. Zeros when metrics have not synced yet.

type.description: URI identifying the problem class; resolves to a documentation page.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem class.

status.description: HTTP status code, duplicated from the response line.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Never parse it.

code.description: Finite stable machine-readable code — the value SDKs branch on. New codes may appear over time; treat unknown values as a generic error.

request_id.description: Request correlation id, identical to the Request-Id response header. Quote it in support requests.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document — every non-2xx /v1 response has this shape with Content-Type application/problem+json.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the offending field, e.g. "/scheduled_at".

ChannelList.description: All connected channels for the organization. Not paginated: the channel count is plan-bounded (max 50).

id.description: Stable channel identifier. Use it in post variants.

platform.description: Social platform this channel publishes to.

handle.description: Account handle or display name, e.g. "@postifyhq".

avatar_url.description: Profile image URL, if the platform provides one.

followers.description: Follower count at last sync, if available.

status.description: Connection health. Only `live` channels can publish; `reauth_required` needs the owner to reconnect in the app.

last_sync_at.description: When channel metadata was last refreshed (ISO-8601 UTC).

last_error.description: Most recent connection error, if any.

created_at.description: When the channel was connected (ISO-8601 UTC).

has_more.description: True when another page exists after `next_cursor`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page — pass as `after`. Reusing a cursor with a different query is rejected.

MediaList.description: One page of assets, newest first.

status.description: `pending` until the upload is completed; only `ready` assets should be attached to posts.

url.description: Durable URL for the asset — use this as `media[].url` when creating posts. Null until the upload completes.

duration_sec.description: Duration in seconds for audio/video, when known.

created_at.description: When the asset was created (ISO-8601 UTC).

asset_id.description: The pending asset — complete it after the PUT succeeds.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL. PUT the raw bytes here with the same Content-Type.

expires_at.description: When the presigned URL stops working (ISO-8601 UTC).

CreateUploadResponse.description: Upload ticket: PUT the bytes to `upload_url`, then POST /v1/media/uploads/{id}/complete.

has_more.description: True when another page exists after `next_cursor`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page — pass as `after`. Reusing a cursor with a different query is rejected.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Consult `deliveries` for per-channel outcomes — a `published` post can still contain failed channels (partial delivery).

body.description: Channel-agnostic base text the variants derive from.

scheduled_at.description: When the post is scheduled to publish (ISO-8601 UTC).

published_at.description: When the post finished publishing (ISO-8601 UTC).

created_at.description: When the post was created (ISO-8601 UTC).

deliveries.description: Latest delivery outcome per channel. Empty until a publish is attempted.

Post.description: A post across one or more channels.

channel_id.description: The channel this variant publishes to (see /v1/channels).

body.description: The text published to the channel.

stage.description: Latest delivery stage. `indexed`/`acked` are success; `failed`/`dlq` are terminal failures; anything else is in flight.

external_id.description: The platform's id for the published item, once known.

error.description: Most recent delivery error, if any.

Delivery.description: Per-channel delivery outcome of a publish.

status.description: State after acceptance. Poll GET /v1/posts/{id} for per-channel `deliveries`.

PublishPostResponse.description: Publish accepted — delivery continues in the background.

limit.description: Plan ceiling for the period. Null means unlimited.

remaining.description: `limit - used`, floored at 0. Null when unlimited.
